<?php
// E2E probe (test only): sets the saved 3-D Secure mode, or removes it (a fresh install).
add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cz3s'] ) || 'mode' !== $_GET['cz3s'] ) { return; }
	$s = get_option( 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings', array() );
	unset( $s['three_d_secure_mode'], $s['enable_3d_secure'], $s['enable_3ds'] );
	$v = isset( $_GET['v'] ) ? sanitize_key( $_GET['v'] ) : 'off';
	if ( in_array( $v, array( 'off', 'attempt', 'required' ), true ) ) { $s['three_d_secure_mode'] = $v; }
	update_option( 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings', $s );
	delete_option( 'cardz3n_gw_3ds_blocked' );
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' ); echo wp_json_encode( array( 'ok' => true ) ); exit;
} );
